title: Kitchen Cabinet Planner
prompt:
Create a single HTML file implementing an interactive 3D Kitchen Cabinet Planner using Three.js and GLTFLoader.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 10) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 7) with intensity 0.8 and castShadow=true.
- Create a floor plane (20x20, color #d4c4a8) at y=0 representing the kitchen floor.
- Create three wall planes: back wall at z=-5 (20x6, color #f0ece4), left wall at x=-10 (10x6, color #ede8df), right wall at x=10 (10x6, color #ede8df). Walls start at y=0 and extend up.
- Load the 'DamagedHelmet.glb' model using GLTFLoader. Scale it to (0.3, 0.3, 0.3) and place it on the kitchen counter as a decorative item (initially at position (3, 2.6, -3.5)). Name the loaded model 'decorHelmet'.

## Cabinet System
- Create cabinet units as THREE.Group objects with box geometries:
  1. 'baseCabinet1': Base cabinet at (-4, 0.5, -4.5), size 2x1x0.6, color #8B6914
  2. 'baseCabinet2': Base cabinet at (-1.5, 0.5, -4.5), size 2x1x0.6, color #8B6914
  3. 'baseCabinet3': Base cabinet at (1, 0.5, -4.5), size 2x1x0.6, color #8B6914
  4. 'wallCabinet1': Wall cabinet at (-4, 3.5, -4.8), size 2x1.2x0.4, color #A0822A
  5. 'wallCabinet2': Wall cabinet at (-1.5, 3.5, -4.8), size 2x1.2x0.4, color #A0822A
- Add a countertop: a thin box (8x0.1x0.7, color #404040) at y=1.05 spanning across base cabinets from x=-5 to x=3, z=-4.5.
- Each cabinet should have a door child mesh (front face) that can animate open (rotate around Y-axis by -PI/2 over 0.5 seconds).

## Selection & Interaction
- Implement raycasting on click to select cabinets. Selected cabinet gets an emissive highlight (emissive color #ffcc00, emissiveIntensity 0.3). Store selected cabinet name in state.
- When a cabinet is selected, show a DOM panel (id='cabinetPanel') with:
  - Cabinet name display (id='cabinetName')
  - Color picker (id='colorPicker') to change cabinet color
  - 'Open/Close Door' button (id='toggleDoor')
  - 'Delete Cabinet' button (id='deleteCabinet')
  - Width slider (id='widthSlider', range 1-4, step 0.5) to resize cabinet width
- Clicking empty space deselects (hide panel).

## Keyboard Controls
- Arrow keys (Left/Right/Up/Down): Move selected cabinet by 0.5 units in x/z. Cabinets snap to 0.5 grid.
- 'R' key: Rotate selected cabinet 90 degrees around Y-axis.
- 'A' key: Add a new base cabinet at (0, 0.5, -2) with default size.
- 'H' key: Toggle the decorHelmet visibility.

## Drag & Drop
- Hold Shift + mouse drag to move the selected cabinet along the floor plane (xz plane at cabinet's y).

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- cabinetCount: number of cabinets in scene
- selectedCabinet: name of selected cabinet or null
- doorStates: object mapping cabinet name to 'open'|'closed'
- cabinetPositions: object mapping cabinet name to {x, y, z}
- cabinetColors: object mapping cabinet name to hex color string
- cabinetWidths: object mapping cabinet name to width value
- helmetVisible: boolean
- helmetPosition: {x, y, z}
- totalBaseUnits: count of base cabinets
- totalWallUnits: count of wall cabinets
- lastAction: string describing last user action

## HUD
- Top-left HUD (id='hud') showing: 'Cabinets: {count} | Selected: {name|None}'
- Bottom status bar (id='statusBar') showing last action.

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Ensure all numerical values are never NaN.
physics_constraints: Cabinets must snap to 0.5-unit grid. Cabinets cannot move below y=0 (floor). Base cabinets y-center is always 0.5. Wall cabinets y-center is always 3.5. Cabinet widths must be between 1 and 4. Positions must stay within room bounds: x in [-9, 9], z in [-4.8, 4].
